remarks: Mint updated spacious 4 level Town House, in a great location on the Stamford/Darien border. 2 Bedrooms + 2 extra rooms. 2 full baths and 2 1/2 Baths. Primary Bedroom with full bath and walk in closet. Gourmet eat in kitchen with stainless steel appliances granite counters, high end cabinetry w/ sliders to the patio. Loft on the third floor and Family room in the lower level with powder room. Hardwood floors on main level. 1 car garage plus 1 additional parking spot. Close to I-95, Merritt, & Springdale Train Station. 2-year lease or more preferred. Available 8/1/2026.
